description: One Irish company by its CRO number (the Companies Registration Office's statutory register number), from the CRO's own Company Records open data. Returns current registered name, status, company type, registered address, eircode, incorporation date, last/next annual-return dates, last accounts date and dissolution date when applicable. Use ie_search_companies first if you only have a name.

cro_number.description: CRO company number, e.g. "249885" (Ryanair Holdings plc).

name: ie_get_company
